file: 372 Minecraft Was Originally Called Cave Game.mp4

lines.t: Before it was Minecraft, it was called Cave Game.

full.credit: Clips: Notch's Cave Game test (re-upload); Bacon (YouTube)

lines.t: In May 2009, Notch started a small project to test how caves could be generated. It only had grass and cobblestone.

full.credit: Clips: Notch's Cave Game test (re-upload); Bacon (YouTube)

lines.t: On May 13th, he posted a video of it. He'd only been working on it for about two days.

full.credit: Clips: Notch's Cave Game test (re-upload); Bacon (YouTube)

lines.t: Four days later, on May 17th, the first public version came out. Now it's the best-selling game ever.

full.credit: Clips: Notch's Cave Game test (re-upload); Bacon (YouTube)

lines.t: Would Cave Game have been a better name?

full.credit: Clips: Notch's Cave Game test (re-upload); Bacon (YouTube)
